Config_EnableAnomalyProtection_Tooltip: Detects sudden price drops below the historical average to protect your profits.
Config_AnomalyCrashThreshold_Tooltip: Percentage drop from the true market value required to trigger crash protection.
Config_AnomalyStrategy_Tooltip: Action to take when a market crash is detected.
Config_GlobalIgnoreHq_Tooltip: If checked, HQ and NQ items are evaluated together. The absolute lowest price will be targeted regardless of quality.
Config_GlobalHqPremium_Tooltip: Added value to the NQ price when evaluating a HQ item and no HQ competitors exist.
Label_Profiles_Tooltip: Create custom profiles to override global pricing rules for specific items or categories.
Override_IgnoreHq_Tooltip: Overrides the global 'Ignore HQ' setting for items in this profile.
Override_HqPremium_Tooltip: Overrides the global 'HQ Premium' for items in this profile.
Override_UndercutAmount_Tooltip: Overrides the global undercut amount for items in this profile.
Config_EnableStorageProtection_Tooltip: Prevents Marketeer from automating your own storage items and ignores competitors with absurdly high prices.
Config_StorageProtectionThreshold_Toolti: Any listing (yours or competitors) at or above this price will be completely ignored by the pricing algorithms.
